extraction_caveats:
1. The maintenance schedule is presented as discrete mileage/month milestones (not a simple repeating table), requiring reconstruction of repeat intervals by pattern analysis across pages 493–509.
2. Standard schedule engine oil & filter replacement: every 7,500 miles/6 months starting at 7,500.
3. Severe use oil interval is every 5,000 miles/6 months.
4. Intelligent Key battery: Standard schedule shows replacement at 45,000 mi/36 mo, 67,500 mi/54 mo, 90,000 mi/72 mo, and 112,500 mi/90 mo — every 22,500 miles/18 months. An inspection appears at 22,500 mi/18 mo.
5. Engine drive belts are marked with '*'. First standard appearance is at 60,000 mi/48 mo; then 75k, 90k, 105k, 120k — approximately every 15,000 miles after first appearance.
6. EVAP vapor lines & fuel lines are marked with '*'.
7. Engine coolant first replacement is 105,000 miles/84 months; subsequent interval is every 75,000 miles/60 months per footnote (4) on page 508.
8. ATF capacity is listed as 'Refill to proper level' in the manual without a specific US quart figure.
9. Spark plug gap replacement threshold: 0.053 in (1.35 mm) even if within mileage interval.
10. The severe-use brake fluid, transfer fluid, and differential gear oil replacement intervals were reconstructed from the pattern of severe-schedule entries across pages 495–509.
11. Brake lines and cables appear at standard 15k, 30k, 45k, 60k, 75k, 90k, 105k, 120k — every 15,000 miles/12 months, not every 30,000.
12. Brake pads/rotors standard inspection appears at every 15,000-mile standard interval (15k, 30k, 45k, 60k, 75k, 90k, 105k, 120k).
13. ATF standard inspection appears at every 15,000-mile standard interval (15k, 30k, 45k, 60k, 75k, 90k, 105k, 120k).
14. Severe brake fluid pattern: 10k, 20k, 30k, 40k, 50k, 60k, 70k, 80k, 90k, 100k, 110k — every 10,000 miles/12 months.
